messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync 4 finalize private VPC+KMS design partner intake. Target 6 partners, 4-week onboarding. Need recruitment criteria, feedback cadence, and acceptance gates. Can we lock this?
Riley (Solutions): +1. Suggested split: 2 infra-first startups, 2 regulated enterprises, 2 mid-market self-hosts. Small hands-on infra teams only.
Jo (DevEx): I'll draft a one-page runbook + minimal support matrix for partners.
Marc (Eng): We need clear telemetry gates: p95 latency, kv_cache_miss_rate, and OOM/restart counts. Define thresholds after first partner baseline.
Priya (SRE): Ops ask: can we provide 2 business-hour triage during the 4-week window? Requires on-call coverage & a partner incident playbook.
Ken (Legal): NDA + DPA addendum needed for private deployments. Legal turnaround ~3 business days. Include EU data residency checkbox.
Maya (Customer Success): I'll pull 10 candidates from inbound queue. Offer: 3 months Dedicated credits + named support. Need a short outreach script.
Aisha (PM): Draft screener: 1) Do you run VPC or on-prem? 2) Comfortable with pre-release binaries/debug access? 3) Primary use case? 4) Infra team size? 5) Regulatory constraints? 6) Will you join weekly async + 60m sync?
Riley (Solutions): Add: "Can you provide a test dataset or representative queries?"
Jo (DevEx): Runbook will include a checks.sh health snippet and troubleshooting steps.
Marc (Eng): Acceptance for GA: all partners pass onboarding gates; no major regressions on core eval prompts; >=80% say first-week performance is usable. Any major regression pauses rollout.
Aisha (PM): Action items: Jo runbook Tue EOD, Ken NDA/DPA Wed, Maya outreach Wed EOD (10 candidates), Marc/Priya baseline with partner-1 week1, Riley update screener. I'll schedule kickoff.
calendar-bot: Event "Private Beta Kickoff: partner-ops" scheduled for 2024-11-07 16:00 UTC.
Aisha (PM): If no objections by EOD I'll lock plan. :thumbsup:
